name: ox-cli-recap
description: Answer "what value am I getting from SageOx?" with receipts, not vibes. Auto-fire when the user asks "is SageOx worth it", "what has SageOx done for me", "what am I getting out of SageOx", "should I keep using this", "was SageOx worth it this week", or says "ox recap" / "give me a recap". Run `ox recap --json` and narrate a tight, personal, prose answer from the `guidance` field — never invent value, never cite a bare statistic or a time-saved/dollar figure, ground every claim in a receipt from the bundle.
